about: Sites Unbrowse can't get past yet (Lewis, 25 Oct 2026): every one goes here; one is pinned as the next target; when a measured run passes it without a browser it is marked won, with that run, and the next is pinned. scripts/rules/test_release_gates.py holds these rules. Copied on 19 Nov 2026 from the ledger kept until then outside the repository (UNB-208).

Input moves the answer. URL /flights/showfarefirst?dcity=sin&acity=bkk&ddate=... (listing 404s). TWO general signing-sandbox DOM fixes: (1) 8a69d085 created+inserted nodes findable by id (createElement/appendChild register into searchable 'created' list); (2) 1eb78f7d parsed element holds ownerDocument - elementOf's Object.assign(out,dom(),out) dropped dom()'s non-enumerable ownerDocument getter, and React createRoot's listenToAllSupportedEvents reads node.ownerDocument (var t=nodeType===9?node:node.ownerDocument; t[marker]) -> 'reading _reactListening of undefined' -> app never mounted. trip.com mounts into getElementById('main') (parsed). Fix re-holds ownerDocument as a getter on the merged element (NOT enumerable: that evaluates the getter during g.document init when g is in TDZ -> ReferenceError, broke 30 tests). Red-first both, 1066 learn tests green. Sandbox now signs the call with w-payload-source/x-ctx-wclient-req/x-ctx-* headers. Eleventh browserless win. Refinement: GetLowPriceInCalender is the price calendar; airline/flight detail is FlightListSearchSSE. Remaining sandbox noise (not blocking): ipoll-sdk script timeout 2000ms, RLIMIT_FSIZE=0 confinement -> page telemetry EFBIG, a list-ssr-gateway 'reading add' error.
